claims.claim: The Combat Reaction Unit operates Sunday to Thursday, 09:00 to 17:00, on 03-6401400.

claims.claim: At a general hospital ER, if you are not admitted after the examination you are charged an ER fee, unless you received a specific referral to that medical centre from an authorized party together with a Form 17 commitment.

claims.claim: The Ministry of Health helpline index states that Sahar operates 24 hours a day, all year, via chat on its site.

claims.claim: The association of rape crisis centres publishes national hotlines 1202 for women and 1203 for men, plus sector lines: Arab women 04-6566813, religious women 02-6730002, religious men 02-5328000. The service is free and runs 7 days a week, 24 hours a day.
claims.raw_snippet: לנשים ערביות - 04-6566813

claims.claim: Section 6 (סעיף 6) of the Treatment of Mental Patients Law: a district psychiatrist may order in writing that a person be brought urgently for a psychiatric examination where all three conditions are met: illness substantially impairing judgment or reality-testing; liability to place self or another in immediate physical danger; and refusal to be examined by a psychiatrist.
claims.raw_snippet: פסיכיאטר מחוזי רשאי להורות בכתב כי אדם יובא בדחיפות לבדיקה פסיכיאטרית

claims.claim: Section 7 (סעיף 7) covers the non-urgent compulsory examination: substantial impairment of judgment or reality-testing, plus one of non-immediate physical danger, severely impaired ability to meet basic needs, causing severe mental suffering to another disrupting their normal way of life, or serious damage to property, plus refusal to be examined.
claims.raw_snippet: יכולתו לדאוג לצרכיו הבסיסיים פגומה בצורה קשה

claims.claim: Section 8 (סעיף 8): an examination order under sections 6 or 7 is valid for ten days from the day it is given.
claims.raw_snippet: תהיה בתוקף במשך עשרה ימים מיום נתינתה

claims.claim: A compulsory psychiatric examination of a minor under this section is carried out by a psychiatrist specialising in children and adolescents, on the application of a social worker under the Youth (Care and Supervision) Law.
claims.raw_snippet: בדיקה פסיכיאטרית של קטין לפי סעיף זה, תיערך בידי פסיכיאטר מומחה לילדים ולנוער

claims.claim: Section 4A of the Sick Pay Law (סעיף 4א לחוק דמי מחלה): an employer may not dismiss an employee absent from work due to illness during the sick-pay entitlement period accrued under the law or a collective agreement, up to the maximum entitlement period under section 4.
claims.raw_snippet: מעסיק לא יפטר עובד שנעדר מעבודתו עקב מחלתו, במהלך תקופת הזכאות לדמי מחלה הצבורה לו לפי חוק זה

claims.claim: The section 4A (סעיף 4א) dismissal protection does not apply where the employer gave prior notice of dismissal before the illness absence began, or where the workplace ceased operating or the employer was declared bankrupt or a winding-up order was issued.
claims.raw_snippet: המעסיק נתן לעובד הודעה מוקדמת לפיטורים
